_comment: Merge gate for the live agent eval (audit/evals/check-thresholds.mjs). Zero-tolerance metrics are hard limits; the rest are floors relative to the last accepted run on main. Lowering a floor needs a reason in the PR.
_budget_comment: Raised 2026-11-20 when the live eval moved from gpt-oss:120b on Ollama Cloud ($0.15/1M input) to Claude Haiku 4.5 on mwapi ($1/1M input list price). Run 44588579510 measured 14824 prompt tokens/turn, p95 29154 ms, $0.0168/case with 100% quality; the old limits were sized for the cheaper model.
